items.description: Every --strata-* variable for Harbor (light, dark, both densities). Import styles/strata-harbor.css once, at your app root.

items.name: dashboard-overview
items.title: Dashboard overview
items.description: An account overview: app header with a command menu, notifications and account menus, KPI tiles, an alert, recent activity and a quick-action form.
items.docs: Render <DashboardOverview /> inside your ThemeScope (it follows the theme, scheme, density and locale around it). Its copy and data live in components/dashboard-overview/dashboard-overview.content.ts: pass your own object as `content` to translate or rebrand it.

items.name: request-flow
items.title: Request flow
items.description: A three-step request with inline validation, an error summary, evidence upload with progress, a confirmation dialog and a success state.
items.docs: Render <RequestFlow /> inside your ThemeScope (it follows the theme, scheme, density and locale around it). Its copy and data live in components/request-flow/request-flow.content.ts: pass your own object as `content` to translate or rebrand it.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in

items.docs: Render <SignIn /> inside your ThemeScope (it follows the theme, scheme, density and locale around it). Its copy and data live in components/sign-in/sign-in.content.ts: pass your own object as `content` to translate or rebrand it.
